column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3635's migration/workflow_names_become_exact_on_sqlserver_test.go builds a scratch SQL Server database (newMSSQLScratchDB) and skips there when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset. Two whole tests, no subtests, one skip each. test-go/support sets only the PostgreSQL DSN; they RUN in multi-db/mssql. Measured 2026-10-30 by running this job's packages with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set and reading the skip names: both appear.
same two tests, same scratch-database skip: multi-db/mysql runs ./migration/... with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, so neither can build a SQL Server database.
